event.summary: A shooting incident at Virginia State University resulted in five individuals being injured, with one in critical condition. The shooting occurred near the university's residence halls, prompting a campus lockdown as police investigate multiple suspects involved in the incident.

timeline.title: Shooting at Virginia State University Leaves Five Injured; One Suspect Arrested
timeline.summary: A shooting at Virginia State University occurred early Saturday morning, injuring five individuals, one of whom is in critical condition. Police reported that multiple suspects were involved, and one suspect, a 19-year-old named Camron Harris, was arrested after being found hiding in a dorm closet. Authorities continue to search for additional suspects.
